title: Automate cost-optimization defaults: batching, caching, and quantization profiles
author: Ayesha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Reduce unit inference costs and make cost-saving defaults available out-of-the-box for new and existing deployments. This PR centralizes heuristics for batching and prefix/KV caching defaults, introduces a first-pass quantization profile registry for common model families, and wires unit economics reporting so we can recommend profiles automatically. Changes are conservative: defaults are opt-in for existing Dedicated/Private customers but enabled for new hosted deployments. Summary of changes below. Implementation details: 1) Batching and caching: added a new cost_optimization module that exposes batch_size_policy and kv_cache_policy. Policies are driven by simple per-model heuristics and a dynamic feedback loop that adjusts batch sizes every 10 minutes based on observed latency percentiles and token throughput. Default configs applied at model-registration time and surfaced via the Console. KV cache policy introduces safe TTLs for prefix caches and a per-customer max_kv_memory setting to prevent OOM on small nodes. 2) Quantization profiles: new profiles registry (json-backed, editable by ops) with initial profiles for LLaMA-2 and Mistral variants (int8, int4 fallback). Profiles include expected perf delta and quality risk tag. Profiles are selectable per-deployment and automatically suggested by the unit economics service when cost thresholds are exceeded. 3) Unit economics tooling: added a unit_econ evaluator that correlates latency/cost/quality signals and emits recommendations via the recommendations API. The evaluator consumes trace-level token counts and per-route cost reports and writes recommendations to config-store. 4) Console & API changes: Console shows recommended profile and an "Apply recommendation" action. API endpoints to preview expected token-cost change for a profile were added. 5) Telemetry and safety: new metrics (rwi_batch_size, rwi_kv_cache_hit_rate, rwi_quant_profile_suggestion) and alert thresholds. Default suggestion frequency throttled to avoid recommendation spam. Rollout plan: gated feature flag for hosted; opt-in toggle for Dedicated and Private with a migration tool to preview impact. Testing: unit + integration tests added for the policy engine; end-to-end load tests in perf-canary showing median token cost reduction of ~18% on Mistral workloads with negligible quality delta for int8 profiles. See CI checks and canary report links in commits. Backwards compat: defaults are additive; no change to existing per-deployment configs unless opted in. Related: ENG-2102, ENG-2175, PM-98.

release_notes: Adds automated cost-optimization defaults: adaptive batching, safe KV cache defaults, quantization profile registry, and unit-economics driven recommendations. New Console recommendations card and API endpoints to preview/apply profiles. Opt-in for existing Dedicated/Private deployments; enabled for new hosted deployments. See docs/optimization/quant-profiles.md for guidance.
